## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; a bug fix comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] Tests of the affected packages, `npm run lint` and `npm run format` pass locally.
- [ ] A changeset is added (`npm run changeset`) if a library package changed.
- [ ] Framework adapters contain wiring only: behavior lives in the core, plugins or extensions.
- [ ] Roles, keyboard and names follow the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern, if the change touches them.
- [ ] Documentation (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/`, `README.md`) is updated, if a rule or the public API changed.
